description: Queue a crawl of a whole site and return a job_id immediately; a worker runs the crawl and the pages count against the account's rolling 30-day page budget. Use it only when the user asks to crawl or audit a site, or names a number of pages; a request to check a single URL, even a homepage, is check_page, and never start a crawl alongside check_page unasked. Pass the max_pages the user named. One crawl per account runs at a time. Poll crawl_status with the job_id until state is "finished", then read the results with issues_summary and query_issues. max_pages defaults to 500 and is capped at 2000 and at the pages remaining in the budget. JavaScript rendering (spa) is not available on the hosted connector.

audit_profile.description:
Which analyzers to run: "full" (default), "standard", "core",
"critical", or "quick". Use "quick" or "critical" when the user wants a
fast answer rather than a complete audit.

max_pages.description:
Maximum number of pages to fetch. Defaults to 500. Raise it only when
the user has asked for a full-site audit and accepts a longer run.

spa.description:
Render JavaScript with a headless browser. Much slower; use only for
single-page apps.

url.description: Absolute URL to start crawling from, including the scheme.

name: start_crawl
